items.title: How Does Ciena (CIEN) Change The Optical Networking Race With 800 Gb/s?
items.summary: Ciena (NYSE:CIEN) and research network Internet2 set a new record for 800 Gb/s terrestrial optical transmission over 2,104 kilometers. The trial used Ciena’s WaveLogic 6 Nano coherent pluggable technology to send 800 Gb/s over Internet2’s production network infrastructure. Internet2 expects to apply this 800 Gb/s over 2,104 kilometers capability to upgrade its backbone, targeting higher capacity for research data traffic.
